errors.evidence: The color for 'Negation' is described as 'light peach/orange' but the figure shows a distinct orange color.
The color for 'Approximate Quantities' is described as 'pale yellow/cream' but the figure shows a beige color.
The color for 'Disjunctive' is described as 'very light bluish/gray' but the figure shows a light blue color.
The description does not explicitly state that the segments do not follow a specific order based on size, though it is implied.

errors.text_span: The left pie chart titled “Categorical” presents the distribution of four categorical logic-related types, shown as four colored slices with percentage labels placed inside the segments and no separate legend. The slices are Universal Quantifiers (light blue) at 29.07%, Limiter (light pink) at 27.91%, Negation (light peach/orange) at 27.91%, and Existential Quantifiers (light green) at 15.12%; no slice is exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segment arrangement does not appear strictly ordered by size.
errors.evidence: The description is unnecessarily repetitive, particularly in stating the absence of a legend and visual emphasis multiple times.

errors.text_span: The middle pie chart titled “Approximate Number Generation” shows a breakdown across three categories, displayed as three pastel slices with the category names and percentages written inside and no legend. The slices are Approximate Quantities (pale yellow/cream) at 45.03%, Comparative Relationships (light blue) at 36.26%, and Absolute Absence (light lavender) at 18.71%; the chart uses standard contiguous wedges with no exploded segments or special highlighting, and the slice ordering does not appear strictly monotonic by percentage.
errors.evidence: The description includes redundant details about the absence of a legend and visual emphasis, as well as unnecessary elaboration on slice ordering.

errors.text_span: The right pie chart titled “Disjunctive & Conjunctive” depicts a two-category split using two slices with internal percentage labels and no legend. The chart consists of Disjunctive (very light bluish/gray) at 49.51% and Conjunctive (very light pink/gray) at 50.49%, forming an almost even division; neither slice is offset or emphasized beyond the central labeling, and the two segments are arranged as a simple left–right split.
errors.evidence: The description repeats the absence of a legend and visual emphasis, and includes unnecessary details about segment arrangement.
